description:
Ye Kyung-jun, who works at a royal palace, is suddenly hit on by a man while heading home after a grueling day. But this guy—he’s in full cosplay, complete with horns, ears, and even a tail! Clinging to Kyung-jun, the man insists they’ve finally met at last. Flustered but unable to resist the man’s looks—exactly his type—Kyung-jun decides to go for a one-night stand.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000049936), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11150230), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/wt_ssj), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/shinsujeon)
